fixture.scope: insert-only, no TTL/tombstones; globally unique scalar ck maps to one partition

picker.reason: same explicit four native SST inputs; native event scheduling not replayed

physical_bytes.reason: actual Data.db and onDiskLength recorded; an exact serialization byte predictor is not implemented

materialization.reason: native compaction output scanned directly; no CQL writer round trip

approximation.note: Production PLR/KMV merge and materialized-key iterator on identical native inputs, unsplit union; not the production picker or shard splitter. Per-output max timestamp is the production representation.

first_job_decomposition.scope: same first job only; exact-count/error-zero lanes are diagnostic interventions, not production changes

stopped_at: first approximate output divergence; no later jobs executed
